page.notes: The first word of the text is set as a decorated initial; read as "Constantia", uncertain. "iniuri[?]issimis" and "attulerit[?]" are doubtful readings. "utē[?]" at the start of the line after "Inter" is unclear and may be show-through. The page edge cuts off the left margin of the lines, so some initial letters (e.g. "tormentū", "cōstā-") are reconstructed from context. Marginal notes are on the right side only; the note "Florentius publicè mo-ri optat." is printed in two lines and is joined here.
